LIVE RECURRENCE (2026-08-14) under parallel multi-session writes, canonical
/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker. Observed: HEAD ahead of origin/tickets by 4
unpushed ticket commits (EDIT + FILE_IMPACT for cef7-7ac5-18e6-41a3 + 2 "Merge
origin/tickets (auto-reconcile)" merges), working tree dirty with 119 uncommitted .archived
deletions, 126 stray .write.lock files, zero .tmp-event-*. Recovery: `git checkout -- .`
restored the 119 tracked .archived (non-destructive; they exist on HEAD), tree went clean,
the stranded commits then converged to origin (ahead/behind 0/0). The dirty tree REAPPEARED
within minutes — traced to a ticket CLOSE (cinderlike-lucky-akitainu in_progress->closed)
whose maybe_compact() spawned a detached sweep, concurrent with closes from other sessions
on unpatched code. This is abort variant (b) (tracked .archived deletions), DISTINCT from the
untracked-overwrite variant fixed by 1757 — evidence that compaction atomicity (this ticket)
is required IN ADDITION to the reconverge-side recovery. Store re-recovered and healthy;
parallel pickup agents paused on tracker writes pending durable fix.
